history.summary: A freehold 1,625 sqft 4BR at Olloi, a tiny 34-unit D15 (Joo Chiat/Eunos) boutique completed 2022, at $3.18M / $1,957 psf. Freehold East Coast location is the appeal, but a 34-unit block, a $3.18M quantum, and an unreliable 5-txn rate make exit risk high.
history.rating_rationale: Web research confirms Olloi is only 34 units, freehold, TOP 2022, with recent resale ~$2,227 psf. The listing's $1,957 psf looks ~12% below that average, but that's because this is one of the larger 1,625 sqft 4BR units — large-unit PSF is naturally lower, so it isn't the bargain it appears. The 34-unit scale means very thin liquidity and no facilities of scale; new_launch_bias is flagged and the rate rests on just 5 txns (unreliable). At $3.18M the quantum is well above the deep buyer band. Freehold + prime D15/Joo Chiat is a genuine long-term land-value positive, which keeps this at Neutral rather than Avoid.
red_flags: 34-unit boutique — very thin liquidity, no facilities of scale
$3.18M quantum well above the deep buyer band
Rate from only 5 txns + new_launch_bias flag — unreliable; low PSF is a large-unit artefact
catalysts: Freehold in prime D15 Joo Chiat/East Coast (durable land value)
Walkable to Eunos MRT / Joo Chiat lifestyle belt
